_comment: Tracks image assets that have a re-created candidate file sitting alongside the accepted production file. Nothing in data/questions_v1.json references a *_candidate.webp path -- these are review-only and never served to students until explicitly promoted (candidate file renamed over the accepted one, in a separate future change). See docs/v2.0.1_image_replacement_brief.md for the full spec each candidate was built against.

candidates.notes: Old ellipse-lungs + rounded-rect-grid-heart geometric placeholder replaced with a real heart silhouette (color-split left/right) and lung silhouettes with a concave mediastinal border, plus a capillary-mesh body shape. Old SVG is preserved in git history at commit c4fc4b7.
